rules.name: Photocorrosion needs at least three supporting papers
rules.description: Synthetic project policy used to demonstrate theme coverage checks.
rules.message: Theme {identifier} has {count} supporting paper(s); project target is {minimum}.
rules.suggested_action: Add more user-verified notes and claims before treating this theme as review-ready.

rules.name: Photocorrosion needs at least one strong claim
rules.description: Flags a theme that is tracked only by weak or speculative claims.
rules.message: Theme {identifier} has {count} strong claim(s); project target is {minimum}.
rules.suggested_action: Re-read the supporting papers or add stronger primary evidence before using confident manuscript wording.

rules.name: Strong claims need a section or page location
rules.description: Strong claim blocks should include a concrete evidence location.
rules.message: Strong claim {identifier} is missing a section/page evidence location.
rules.suggested_action: Add section, page, figure, table, or appendix location in the structured note.

rules.name: Manuscripts should not contain unknown citation keys
rules.description: Runs only when a manuscript draft is passed to the rules command.
rules.message: Manuscript citation {citation_key} is not known to the local registry or BibTeX data.
rules.suggested_action: Correct the citation key or add a verified registry/BibTeX entry.
